# Tallinn

Welcome to Tallinn, where Pipedrive was born.

Come and join Pipedrive’s Tallinn team!

See open positions

## About us

Pipedrive was born in Tallinn. What started as a small startup in a shared office has grown into an international company with an entire building in Tallinn’s vibrant WoHo quarter. Today, Tallinn is home to our engineering and product hub, where 300+ team members from 30+ nationalities work together – many of them engineers.

Pipedrive is proud to be Estonia’s fifth unicorn and has consistently been recognized as one of the best places in the country to work since 2016, according to both the media and our employees. And we’re not just about jobs – at Pipedrive, you’ll have the chance to grow, learn and make a real impact by helping shape a product used by more than 100,000 companies worldwide.

## Our traditions

At Pipedrive, we love to celebrate the moments that matter – from birthdays and work anniversaries to promotions. One of our most beloved traditions is getting together for *Kringle*, a classic Estonian pastry, though you’ll also see pizza, donuts or pancakes make an appearance. To make sure no celebration goes unnoticed, we’ve got a kitchen-alert Slack channel to keep everyone in the loop.

Our biggest annual event is the Summer Garage – a full-day celebration that brings teams together to connect, unwind and enjoy live music performed by our very own band (and sometimes a guest artist or two).

We also host occasional hackathons and innovation accelerators to spark new ideas for improving the product and how we work together.

We believe in a balance of fun and focus. From Lightning Talks where anyone can practice their presentation skills with a topic they care about, to Sudoku tournaments and gaming challenges organized by teammates, there’s always something to get involved in.

We’re also proud to contribute to the wider community: Our team actively supports the local engineering, product and HR scenes in Estonia by hosting in-house meetups, participating in conferences and speaking at events.

Staying active outside of work is also a big part of our culture. Whether it's a friendly game of table tennis, a disc golf match or a padel session – one of the most popular sports among our Tallinn team – there's always fun going on.

## Where you’ll find us

You’ll find us in Tallinn’s modern WoHo district, where our custom-designed office makes it easy to feel at home. Each of our eight themed floors – park, nature, sports, IT, music, art, movies and culture – is fully immersive. Whether you’re jamming on the music floor’s instruments or exploring the art gallery, there’s something for everyone.

The heart of the office is our all-hands area, where people gather for a coffee or something else from our well stocked kitchens. Think smoothies with frozen berries, cereal, fruit, nuts, all kinds of milk, teas and sodas. If you're into fitness or want to unwind, we’ve got a fully equipped gym and an igloo sauna you

Olá Lisboa! Say hello to our fun-loving office in the Portuguese capital.

## About us

Pipedrive made a splash in Lisbon during Web Summit 2016, and our journey took off with the opening of our Lisbon office in 2017. After a few moves, we’re thrilled to call our vibrant Casal Ribeiro space home as of 2023.

With over 200 talented individuals from 25+ countries, Lisbon is one of our engineering hubs. But it’s our customer-facing teams that truly shine – they’re the heartbeat of our mission to keep users smiling. It’s a great place to work, collaborate and have fun while making a real impact!

At our Lisbon office, we thrive on community and collaboration. We cherish lunch breaks to recharge, and as foodies, our official office cake is the delightful Bola de Berlin (bet you thought it was Pastel de Nata). The Lisbon office is also one of the few Pipedrive locations that goes all out for its birthday, a tradition the team takes very seriously.

With such a talented team of customer solutions experts, we host regular “One Day in Your Shoes” events to show off the incredible results they deliver for our customers. Outside of work, we stay active with monthly hikes, competitive padel, table tennis and football, strengthening bonds and team spirit. We’re also big on celebrating. The year closes with our festive winter awards show, honoring achievements with sparkle, applause and shared pride.

# London

Be a part of Pipedrive London’s growth story.

Join our dynamic team in this iconic city.

See open positions

## About us

Our London office is home to a fun and close-knit team of 30+ Pipedrivers. Over the years, we’ve tried it all, from co-working spaces and private offices to going fully remote. In March 2024, we found our new home in Holborn at Uncommon, right in the heart of London.

This small but mighty team represents almost every Pipedrive department (engineering, we’re saving a seat for you) and reflects the global nature of our company. We’re proud of the mix of nationalities, languages, skills and experiences that come together here.

Many of our executive team are also based in London, which means leadership is always close by for the moments that matter.

## Our traditions

Tea, biscuits and big ideas – that’s how many of our best conversations start. While coffee may be serious business at Pipedrive, London proudly leads with tea. You’ll also find cake on the table more often than not, from themed celebration bakes to treats during our weekly “Cake & Catch-up” or twice-monthly All Hands.

Our office culture blends energy and warmth. The buzz of our sales team provides its own soundtrack, and we keep things moving with gym classes, walk-and-talk meetings and the occasional lunchtime museum trip. We also love our rooftop terrace – perfect for summer drinks, team chats and soaking up the skyline.

Dogs are always welcome, and we’ve named our meeting rooms after our favorite local pubs, a small nod to British culture and a big part of what makes this space feel like home.

## Where you’ll find us

You’ll find us in Holborn at Uncommon, a creative and modern workspace in central London. From here, it’s easy to explore everything the city has to offer – Covent Garden, Soho and countless cafés, museums and parks are just steps away.

Our office space offers a balance of comfort and energy. The on-site café is ideal for grabbing coffee or lunch, and our rooftop terrace is a team favorite when the sun’s out. Inside, the space supports collaboration and focus – whether you’re deep in a strategy session or catching up with a teammate over tea.

There’s room here to do your best work and enjoy the people around you. Whether it’s brainstorming over biscuits, heading out for a walk or joining a spontaneous pub night, our London office makes work feel genuinely good.

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

## The Senior Enterprise Engineer opportunity

Statsig is building an Enterprise Engineering team for engineers who want unusually direct ownership of high-stakes customer outcomes. Like a Forward Deployed Engineering team, Enterprise Engineering works extremely close to customers and tackles the technical problems that matter most to them.

The difference is the scope of ownership. Forward Deployed Engineering is often concentrated around implementation or onboarding; Enterprise Engineering is responsible for a customer’s technical success throughout the entire customer journey. You’ll stay close as needs evolve, answering questions, investigating across the stack, identifying root causes, shipping fixes and features, and remaining accountable through resolution.

This is a software engineering role with a tight customer feedback loop. It is ideal for a pragmatic generalist, especially someone with backend or infrastructure depth who enjoys ambiguous problems, production systems, fast decisions, and immediate impact.

## What you’ll do

* Serve on the engineering front line in Unthread, our Slack aggregation and workflow layer, for key customer accounts.
* Answer technical questions by reading the code, tracing behavior, inspecting production signals, and building a clear explanation, not by forwarding the thread.

# Senior Software Engineer

San Francisco, CA

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

**Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI):** Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

## About the Role & Team

Every AI insight, every experiment, every cohort at Amplitude starts with a query. Our in-house OLAP engine, **Nova**, processes trillions of events in real time — turning raw behavioral data into fast, trustworthy answers that power decisions for thousands of product teams worldwide.

We're entering a world where AI agents don't just assist product teams — they ship features, run experiments, and make prioritization calls autonomously. What makes that possible is agents' ability to verify their work against real product data continuously. That makes Nova the critical infrastructure in the loop, and as non-stop agents become the main source of queries, the demand on Nova's throughput, correctness, and operational rigor grows dramatically.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** who wants to go deep on the engine internals and the infrastructure underneath. You'll own significant components of a modern OLAP system — across query execution, columnar storage and encoding, distributed compute, caching, and cloud infrastructure — and drive meaningful improvements to performance, cost-efficiency, and reliability. You'll grow your technical influence through the quality of your code, your design contributions, and your collaboration with other engineers on a team of ~10.

This role is ideal for someone who finds real satisfaction in making a complex distributed system faster, cheaper, and more reliable — and who wants to do that work on a system that directly powers the product experience for thousands of enterprise customers.

Peratera is a UK-based fintech company, founded in 2022 and authorised by the FCA as an Electronic Money Institution.

We are building a modern, all-in-one payment platform that enables businesses to manage global payments and financial operations seamlessly.

Our solution allows companies to open multi-currency accounts, send and receive payments worldwide, and manage cross-border transactions from a single platform.

Our mission is to simplify global finance and remove friction from international business operations.

## Your mission

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will be part of the team building and evolving the user-facing applications behind our financial platform.

# Senior Frontend Engineer (m/f/d)

Remote, Leer

Full-time

Permanent employee

## Role

Everything our users see runs on Next.js and React, and we'd like to hand it to you: the design system it's built from, how fast it loads, and whether everyone can actually use it.

You'll work closely with our software architects, product owners, and fellow developers: code reviews, pair programming, and the technical decisions that stick around.

## Your mission

* You build and maintain our design system in React and Tailwind, so features stay consistent instead of being rebuilt from scratch each time.
* You own frontend performance in Next.js 16 — rendering strategy, bundle size, and what people actually experience on a mediocre connection.
* You treat accessibility as a default, not as cleanup at the end of the sprint.
* You develop the Node.js layer (Express.js, Nest.js) between the UI and our backend services, with Redis where caching helps.
* You push for clean code and automated testing, and you share what you know instead of sitting on it.
* You use coding agents as part of your daily workflow — directing their work, reviewing their output, and fixing what doesn't hold up. Writing code matters; knowing what good code looks like matters more.

## Your profile

* You've spent several years building production frontends with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* You know Tailwind CSS well and you've managed client-side state with Zustand.
* You test what you build — unit and component tests with Vitest, end-to-end tests with Playwright.
* You're comfortable in Node.js with Express.js or Nest.js, and working against APIs from a microservices backend.
* You work well in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), you write clearly, and you're comfortable in English.
* You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or the experience that makes one unnecessary.

## Nice to have

* You've worked with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. We're not in the cloud yet, so this is a plus, not a requirement.

## How you think

We care as much about how you approach a problem as about which frameworks you know. You look past the edges of your own ticket: you notice when a fix really belongs in a different service, you question a process once it has stopped making sense, and you judge your work by whether the whole system got better — not by whether your part shipped. "Not my code" isn't a sentence we use much around here.

## Why us?

You're joining at a point where the engineering foundations themselves are being rebuilt around AI-native workflows — not retrofitted onto legacy decisions, but designed now, while the architecture is still being shaped. That means you don't inherit someone else's five-year-old choices: you help make the calls on how services are split, where AI agents fit into the workflow, and what "good" looks like technically around here. We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults. 

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

## Your competencies

Mindset

Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need.

You own what you build, all the way through, not just until it ships and becomes someone else's problem. The parts that go smoothly and the parts that get messy are both yours to see through. You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

Drive

By now the drive is a track record, not a promise. You have years of hard problems behind you and it shows. You understand the whole stack, or you close any gap in it fast, and the hard problems are the ones you go looking for. You are the one who takes the piece nobody else can crack and finds a way through, then leaves the ground solid enough for everyone else to build on. If the hardest part of a project is not the part you reach for, this is not your seat.

What you bring to the table:

* You make the team better. You speak up when something can be sharper, and you share what you learn instead of sitting on it.
